sources.summary: Design practice POOR Collective has unveiled Power, two flatwoven rugs informed by the brutalist Trellick Tower housing block, which will be on display at London Design Festival. Power is the first mass-produced design product from London-based POOR Collective, a socially minded creative practice with a community development focus.
